Name: Sharogg's Tilesheets (indoor and outdoor structures)
Author: Sharogg
Description:
I am using this mod to add tilesheets that I use in other mods so that they will be centralized and targetable for recolouring. I also wanted to share them in case anyone else finds them useful. I am constantly adding to this whenever I want more options for new mods.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1774348809.png[/img]

[b]For mod users:[/b] Install if you have a mod that requires this as a dependency, otherwise this mod does nothing in your game. Selection of the toned down version is automatic for VPR and Earthy (and the colours in BW2 if you download CMCT), otherwise you will have to manually select it.
[b][b]
For mod makers: [/b][/b]The following list of features describes the tiles that are added by this mod. Please don't include the tilesheet with your mod but list this mod as a dependency instead. If you want to edit them it's fine as long as you keep the dependency. Feel free to reach out to me if you don't understand how some tiles are meant to be used, they are set up in a way to be highly modular to allow for lots of creativity and layering.
[b][b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528136.png[/img]

Bridge tilesheet[/b] (outdoors, seasonal)
[/b][list]
[*]2 curved bridge designs with railings in 4 colours, best 3-5 tiles wide
[*]1 small curved bridge without railings in 3 colours, best 2-3 tiles wide
[*]flat bridge without railings to match curved bridges, 2 directions, any length/width
[*]modified vanilla suspension bridge in 2 colours, modular width and railings
[*]vanilla plank bridges with background removed and in 2 additional colours
[*]modular bridge based on jetty design, 3 colours, 2 directions, any length/width, supports for cliffs and water
[*]shadow option for most bridges
[*]a series of 10 stepping stones (animated) in 3 colour options
[*]A ladder that can cover any tile height
[*]pool tiles based on tide pools with transparent background, so you can combine them with whichever water tiles you want and have a water overlay
[*]two water spouts styles that go with the water tilesheet below
[/list]
[b]Water tilesheet [b](outdoors, seasonal)[/b][/b]
[list]
[*]adds the water to the spouts, based on the spouts in caroline's sunroom and the ones outside the bathhouse
[*]extendable to different tile heights
[*]compatible with Better Water 2 (automatic with CMCT)
[/list][b]
Panorama
[/b][list]
[*]Tree silhouette tilesheet (from Maru's heart event), seasonal, with darker night version
[*]Ocean panorama from Ginger Island, changes automatically to night version
[*]Rainbow overlay
[/list]
[b]Indoor tilesheet[/b]
[list]
[*]Indoor water spouts (same as outdoors but different colours)
[*]bathroom tiles, steam, floor borders, recoloured bushes
[*]room borders to connect in almost any way you can think of (don't mix with vanilla ones to avoid mismatched tiles, that's why vanilla tiles are included. Also meant to be flipped to limit the amount of tiles to be added). Different angles now included.
[*]wainscoting
[*]railings
[*]stairs and ladders
[*]wooden beams
[*]extendable water trough
[/list][b]
Sunroom tilesheet[/b]
[list]
[*]Caroline's sunroom tiles with transparency, plus some additions to make it more versatile (includes some unchanged vanilla tiles as well just to keep it consistent with recolours
[/list][list]
[/list]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528224.png[/img]

[b]Outdoor[/b]: The toned down version should be ok with most recolours. Let me know if it clashes somewhere and I'll try my best to fix it. I'm not currently planning to add recoloured versions for specific outdoor recolours, but you are free to recolour it yourself and I can add it to the main file.
[b]Indoor[/b]: Compatible with Earthy Interiors and VPR, but if you use another recolour you can pick the one that fits best and there shouldn't be any hard clashes. Darker vanilla matching option for wainscoting and room borders, usable with any recolour. Possibly open to adding more compat options if requested.
